params.caption: 🖥️ Razer's new Soma chairs let you feel explosions in-game Razer has revealed two new Soma gaming chairs with built-in haptic motors. The idea: you physically feel what happens on screen, from explosions and impacts to enemies closing in. It is Razer's latest push to bring haptics beyond controllers and headsets. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 22:19 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 🪑 Gimmick or game changer?
